name: @funcd-dev/example-kv-counter
description: A funcd KV example (ADR-0069): a function that increments a per-name counter via context.kv. Authored in TypeScript against @funcd-dev/shim; vite build (@funcd-dev/vite-plugin) bundles it to a self-contained counter.mjs; the I/O contract lives in funcdctl.yaml.
